name: SM_Vehicle_Sedan
description: Mid-size four-door three-box saloon of about the year 2000, generic, no real make. Nose at +X. Body 1.73 wide (1.85 mirror to mirror), roof 1.45, wheelbase 2.80 (axles at x +1.42 and -1.38), wheels 0.65 across with 0.21 tyres, ground clearance 0.20. Bonnet 0.90 high at the nose rising to 1.00 at the cowl, belt line 1.02, boot lid 1.01; windscreen base at x 0.98, top at x 0.30; rear screen top at x -1.00, base at x -1.52. Front door 1.16 long, rear door 0.90. Parts: dark plastic bumpers, two headlamps 0.30 x 0.125 and a dark grille between them, amber indicators in the bumper, red tail lamps 0.34 x 0.13, body-colour mirrors, a dark rub strip along the flanks, chrome door handles, plates 0.30 x 0.15 front and rear. Two wheel faces as swaps: chrome hubcap and dark steel wheel with a small chrome cap. Static: needs a believable underside and wheel wells, and a simple interior if the glass is lighter than the near-black tint of the source. Keep the bonnet no lower than the source: the body collider tops out at 1.08.
gameplay: cover: body 1.08 m, cabin 1.45 m (glass stops bullets, does not break)

name: SM_Vehicle_Taxi
description: The sedan body as a New York yellow cab with dark steel wheels. Extra parts: a roof light at x -0.17 (a lit box 0.16 long x 0.40 wide x 0.085 tall on a dark foot, top at 1.55) showing the medallion number 5K83 on its front and rear faces; black lettering on both front doors, 0.92 x 0.37: "NYC TAXI", "5K83" and a ruled fare card; a black and white checker band 2.40 x 0.07 under the windows on both flanks (two rows of 16 checks); a yellow plate "T·5K83". All invented: no real fleet, medallion or operator.

name: SM_Vehicle_SUV
description: Full-size two-box 4x4, generic. Nose at +X. Body 1.88 wide (2.00 over mirrors and running boards), roof skin 1.78, roof rails to 1.82, wheelbase 2.92 (axles at x +1.50 and -1.42), five-spoke alloy wheels 0.80 across with 0.27 tyres, clearance 0.27. Bonnet 1.12 to 1.20, belt line 1.22, upright tail with the rear screen from x -2.33 to -2.12. Front and rear door glass plus a quarter light. Body-colour bumpers, chrome grille, two roof rails 2.3 long on three feet each, chrome running boards 2.0 x 0.13. One of the two on the block is the player character's own car, parked at the kerb beside the start and seen from a metre away: black, hero quality, clean.
colours: #14161a body of the player car (the source asks for #0b0c0e and its paint chart snaps it)

name: SM_Vehicle_Pickup
description: Full-size single-cab long-bed pickup, generic. Nose at +X. 1.88 wide, cab roof 1.78, wheelbase 3.22 (axles at x +1.72 and -1.50), dark steel wheels 0.78 across, clearance 0.30. Bonnet 1.12 to 1.22, belt line 1.25. Load bed 2.01 long behind the cab (from x -0.56), floor at 0.92, walls 0.35 high, a tailgate, a dark liner; in the bed a spare tyre lying flat (0.66 across) and a timber crate 0.50 x 0.42 x 0.40. Chrome bumpers and grille, plate on the rear bumper.

name: SM_Vehicle_Van
description: Full-size cargo panel van with a short sloping nose, generic. Nose at +X. 1.88 wide, roof skin 2.14 with a roof vent 0.5 x 0.5 on top, wheelbase 3.20 (axles at x +1.70 and -1.50), dark steel wheels 0.72 across, clearance 0.26. Windscreen from x 1.92 at its base to 1.42 at the top; glass only in the cab doors; blank sides. Closed barn doors at the tail: a centre seam, two chrome handles, two small dark panes 0.50 x 0.36 at 1.62. Dark plastic bumpers, grille and mirrors.
gameplay: hard cover: one box to 2.14 m

name: SM_Vehicle_Van_Vulture
description: The crew's van: the cargo van in near-black with both rear barn doors swung open (size given with the doors open). Each leaf 0.85 wide x 1.44 tall, hinged on the rear corners at x -2.53; the right leaf (Blender -Y) open 111.7 degrees, the left 88.8 degrees. Load space visible and modelled: bare dark steel, 2.94 long x 1.52 wide x 1.44 high, floor at 0.60, holding two taped cartons (0.50 x 0.42 x 0.36 with a 0.40 x 0.36 x 0.30 on top) and a timber crate 0.70 x 0.50 x 0.34. Livery, both flanks: a spray stencil of a hunched vulture on a wire in worn bone white, 1.15 x 0.92, centred at x -1.0, height 1.64; an oxblood stripe 3.70 x 0.09 at height 0.78; a marker scrawl without letters 0.66 x 0.29 by the cab door (oxblood on the right flank, bone white on the left). Plate "LWG·4418". Stands beside reel 1 in the middle of the avenue.
colours: #14161a body (the factory default for this variant is #1a1c20)
gameplay: hard cover: one box to 2.14 m; the open doors and load space have no collision

name: SM_Vehicle_BoxTruck
description: Medium-duty conventional-cab straight truck with a dry-freight box, a rental-type truck, generic. Nose at +X. Cab 2.9 long, 2.08 wide, 2.28 high, always white, chrome bumper and grille, mirrors on stalks, five amber marker lamps on the roof. Cargo box 4.56 long x 2.40 wide x 2.25 high (floor 1.05, roof 3.30) in the instance colour with aluminium corner rails, a roll-up rear door 2.24 x 2.09 and two red marker lamps at the top rear corners. Ladder frame; front axle at x +2.95, twin-tyre rear axle at x -2.09 (wheelbase 5.04), wheels 0.88 across; mud flaps; step bumper at 0.55; a cylindrical fuel tank 0.52 across x 0.9 long on the right, a battery box on the left; tail lamps and plate at 0.93. One spray tag per flank of the box, fitted into 2.6 x 1.2 at height 1.90: "RULE" in bone white and "HOLLIS" in gold. Three on the block: mustard, beige, and a charcoal one slewed 60 degrees across the roadway as the roadblock (the "jack-knifed" truck: the same rigid truck, nothing bent).
colours: #c9a23a cargo box of the first truck
#b9b4a6 cargo box of the second truck
#2a2d33 cargo box of the roadblock truck
gameplay: hard cover: box 3.30 m, cab 2.28 m

name: SM_Vehicle_BurnedCar
description: A burned-out saloon: the sedan shell sitting 0.125 lower on four bare rusted rims, no tyres, no glass, no lamps, no bumpers, no trim. Roof on six thin pillars; charred cabin floor, two front seat frames, a rear bench frame and a steering wheel; bonnet sprung open 15 degrees over a black engine bay. Rusted, scaled steel with soot. Sits on a scorch mark in the vacant lot.
gameplay: cover: body 0.96 m; the roof frame stops bullets up to 1.30 m but not bodies

name: SM_Vehicle_StrippedCar
description: A saloon stripped to the shell in the chop shop, raised 0.15 on four jack stands (0.35 tall, at x +-1.0, y +-0.66): no doors (open apertures through the body), no glass, no wheels (rusty brake discs on the hubs), no bumpers or lamps, flat primer, bare floor, gutted dash, open engine bay with one leftover casting.
colours: #7a3b2c red-oxide primer (the one on the block)

name: SM_Vehicle_IPXTruck
description: The extraction truck: an armoured cash-in-transit truck on a medium-duty chassis, generic, in IPX livery. Nose at +X. One welded shell 2.34 wide: short sloped nose, upright split windscreen (two narrow panes, a centre post), cab roof 2.58, vault body 2.86 from the tail to x +0.55, flat flanks tapering 7 percent toward the nose from x +1.30. Wheels 1.00 across x 0.30, dark steel, front axle x +2.05, twin rear at x -1.75; clearance 0.46. Nose: steel ram bumper, dark grille with four bright bars, headlamps on. Roof: five amber clearance lamps, a hatch 0.8 x 0.8 and a vent on the vault, amber markers under the roof line. Flanks: cab door with slot window, chrome handle and a step; two gun ports per side on the vault; mirrors. Tail: step bumper with yellow and black hazard stripes, red tail lamps, a lamp over the doors, plate "KQB·5530" right of centre. Vault interior (seen when the doors open): galvanised lining 3.58 x 1.80 x 1.56, floor at 1.02, three shelves per wall, a ceiling light panel, the IPX lozenge on the bulkhead. Livery: gloss black; a gold waist band 0.11 tall at height 1.36 along both vault flanks, 1.2 m of each cab flank and across the rear doors; on both vault flanks a white panel of art 3.50 x 0.875 centred at x -1.42, height 2.10: the IPX lozenge (0.72 tall), a short gold bar, then "IPX.EXCHANGE", reading left to right from outside; the lozenge alone 0.80 x 0.33 on the bonnet. The lozenge is a typeset stand-in for the real logo: keep it a swappable texture. Six hazard lamps (two rear, two front, two side repeaters) must be separately emissive. Rear door leaves are separate meshes (see vehicle_ipx_truck_door).
colours: #f6c21a gold bar in the flank art
gameplay: objective: extraction point; hard cover, vault 2.86 m, cab 2.58 m

name: SM_Vehicle_IPXTruck_Door
description: One rear vault door leaf of the IPX truck; build the right leaf and mirror it. 0.89 wide x 1.62 tall x 0.07 thick armoured panel with a dark inset, the gold waist band carried across it, an armoured-glass port 0.34 x 0.22 near the top, a chrome lock bar 0.90 tall with a round boss by the centre seam, two hinges on the outer edge. Pivot on the vertical hinge line at the outer edge. Closed, the leaves span height 1.05 to 2.67 on the truck; they swing 108.9 degrees outward in 1.1 s. Art on the outer face at height 1.75: the IPX lozenge 0.62 x 0.26 on the right leaf, "IPX.EXCHANGE" 0.74 x 0.092 on the left leaf.
gameplay: animated part of the extraction truck; no collision of its own

name: SM_Vehicle_Motorbike
description: Standard naked motorcycle, generic, parked on its side stand leaning 7 degrees. Nose at +X. Wheels 0.62 across, 1.32 apart; chrome fork and twin exhausts, round chrome headlamp, air-cooled engine, painted tank, tail and front mudguard, black seat, handlebars 0.5 wide with two mirrors. (In the source the stand is on the side away from the lean; lean the bike onto its stand.)
colours: #1b2a4a tank, tail and mudguard (two on the block)
#14161a tank, tail and mudguard (one on the block)

name: SM_Sign_LicensePlate
description: A licence plate 0.30 wide x 0.15 tall (a flat quad in the source; no thickness given), with a swappable face. Design: off-white with a navy border and number, the header "NEW YORK", a gold band along the bottom; the taxi plate is yellow with a navy band. Five faces, all invented: "HLS·2141", "TKV·9907", "KQB·5530", "LWG·4418" and the taxi "T·5K83". Rule for any new code: three capitals, a middle dot, four digits, nothing that reads as a real person's initials.

name: SM_Gameplay_MasterCase
description: The objective: a master-tape flight case on a hand truck (size is the whole assembly with boombox and beacon). Hand truck: steel sack truck loaded from -X, toe plate 0.30 x 0.30, two tube rails rising to 0.86 and bent into a handle at 0.96, two cross bars, two 0.18 wheels. Case body: black laminate panels, 16 mm aluminium edge extrusions, 30 mm chrome ball corners, 0.42 wide x 0.32 deep x 0.50 tall standing on the toe plate (top of body at 0.53), two chrome butterfly latches on the front (the -Y face), a recessed handle on the +X end, dark foam inside. On the front: an IPX luggage tag 0.20 x 0.10 (off-white card, lozenge, the word "TRACKER", a barcode) and a clipped-on tracker 0.11 x 0.065 x 0.03 with a small lit LCD ("IPX" and signal bars), a green LED and a 0.17 whip antenna. Beacon: a thin dark mast clamped to the handle from 0.90 to 1.22 with a base disc and a domed gold lens 0.104 across (top 1.346); the mast and lens are a separate mesh that is hidden with the reel. Separate meshes that complete it: lid, reel, boombox. Effects built in engine, not modelled: a 6 m gold light shaft above the lens and a 1 m gold glow on the ground.
gameplay: objective (hold to grab 2.4 s); cover 0.66 m

name: SM_Gameplay_MasterCase_Lid
description: The lid of the master case: same shell as the body (black laminate, aluminium edging, chrome ball corners), 0.42 x 0.32 x 0.12. Pivot on the hinge line along its back lower edge. Outside top: the IPX lozenge 0.30 x 0.125. Inside: dark foam, a second lozenge 0.26 x 0.108 and a recessed dark track 0.36 x 0.045 that holds the progress bar (a gold strip 0.34 x 0.03 that grows from its left end). Stands open 95 degrees while the reel is in the case, drops shut in 0.3 s when the reel is taken.

name: SM_Gameplay_MasterReel
description: The master reel: a gold-anodised open-reel tape reel 0.27 across (10.5 inch) and 0.038 thick in the source, two flanges with three wide spoke windows, a dark hub, a full pack of brown tape (radius 0.118). Shown tilted 40 degrees, propped on its square tape box (cardboard, 0.29 x 0.29 x 0.04, a second small mesh). Box label, 0.26 x 0.26: "MASTER REEL", "MURDER INC.", "REEL __ / 3", "SPEED 30 IPS", "TAPE 2 IN · 24 TRK" and a small IPX lozenge. The label says two-inch tape, which would make a real reel about 0.057 thick: see the spec's open questions before choosing.
gameplay: objective item: hidden when the reel is taken

name: SM_Prop_Boombox
description: A 1980s to 1990s portable stereo, generic: body 0.60 wide x 0.19 deep x 0.28 tall, carry handle to 0.34, chrome top strip with four keys, a telescopic aerial. Face (-Y): two speakers 0.16 across behind grilles, a cassette door between them, a tuner scale across the top, a row of six keys (one red), a five-segment level meter (three green, two orange-red) that must be separately emissive. Stands on the ground beside each master case, turned 66 degrees.
gameplay: cover 0.35 m for bullets only (the player is blocked to 0.66 m)

name: SM_Gameplay_PropaneTank
description: A steel LPG cylinder with a guard collar. Dark steel foot ring 0.25 across x 0.045; white body 0.304 across from 0.03 to 0.33; red domed shoulder to 0.47; a white collar 0.20 across from 0.45 to 0.585 with two hand openings; brass valve with a side outlet; red handwheel. A flammable-gas diamond 0.13 x 0.13 (white flame and the class number 2 on red) front and back at height 0.215. Needs an emissive heat mask for the lit state. Collider in play is 0.32 x 0.32 x 0.60.
gameplay: explosive: 50 HP, fuse 1.6 s, blast 6.5 m, 170 damage; cover 0.60 m until it blows

name: SM_Gameplay_PropaneTank_Wreck
description: What is left after the tank blows: the scorched foot ring, tilted, and one torn plate shard 0.16 x 0.11 lying beside it. Soot black, heat-blued steel. A richer torn-open shell is welcome as long as nothing stands higher than about 0.1: the wreck has no collision.

name: SM_Gameplay_WeldingRack
description: An oxy-acetylene welding set on a rack. Steel base plate 0.90 x 0.50 x 0.04; a back frame of two posts to 1.34 with three rails; a chain across the front at 0.82. Two oxygen cylinders (dark green, 0.23 across, 1.42 tall) at x -0.28 and 0 and one acetylene cylinder (maroon, 0.28 across, 1.12 tall) at x +0.28, each with a brass valve and steel cap; two brass regulators with two white-faced gauges each; a red and a green hose looped over the frame; a brass torch hung on it; a placard 0.36 x 0.25 on a white board on the front (-Y): "DANGER", "FLAMMABLE GAS", "NO SMOKING", "NO OPEN FLAME". Needs an emissive heat mask for the lit state. Collider in play is 0.90 x 0.50 x 1.60.
gameplay: explosive: 70 HP, fuse 1.1 s, blast 7.5 m, 210 damage; cover 1.60 m until it blows

name: SM_Gameplay_WeldingRack_Wreck
description: What is left after the rack blows: the scorched, buckled base plate 0.86 x 0.46 and two bent frame posts leaning out of it. Soot black. Burst cylinder fragments are welcome; the wreck has no collision.

name: SM_Street_JerseyBarrier
description: Precast concrete safety barrier, 3.0 long: 0.60 wide at the foot (vertical for 0.075), sloping to 0.33 wide at height 0.33 and to 0.17 wide at the top, 0.81. Two fork-lift slots 0.34 x 0.07 through the foot at x +-0.8. Chipped edges, tyre scuffs, rust weeps. Three dressings as decals: plain; a black marker scrawl 0.8 x 0.34 on one slope; the remains of an orange and white hazard stripe 2.6 x 0.2.

name: SM_Street_TrafficBarrel
description: Plastic channelizer drum: black rubber base ring 0.60 across, stepped body tapering from 0.54 to 0.41 across, flat top with a moulded handle at 1.0. Orange with two white reflective bands (0.30 to 0.50 and 0.68 to 0.84).

name: SM_Street_TrafficCone
description: Traffic cone 0.70 tall on a 0.36 square foot, orange with a white collar from 0.30 to 0.48.

name: SM_Street_Barricade
description: Sawhorse barricade: two A-frames 1.0 tall, two boards 2.4 long (0.20 tall at height 0.9 and 0.14 at 0.5) striped orange and white on both faces, an amber flasher lamp on one end of the top board (steady glow).

name: SM_Street_Dumpster
description: Rear-load steel waste container on four castors: body 1.8 long, 0.92 deep at the bottom and 1.03 at the rim (sloping front toward -Y), from 0.14 to 1.16, three ribs on the front, fork pockets on both ends, two dark plastic lids (one shut, one thrown back with a refuse sack showing). Dented, rust at the seams. Stencil on the front, 0.5 x 0.1: "HOLLIS CARTING" / "718 · 555 · 0144" (invented). One of the two variants adds a white marker scrawl.

name: SM_Street_TrashCan
description: City wire litter basket: steel mesh sides flaring from 0.46 across at the base to 0.57 at the rim, a rolled galvanised rim at 0.90 to 0.94, a solid base, a black liner bag with litter heaped at the top.

name: SM_Street_TrashBags
description: A kerbside pile of five tied refuse sacks, each about 0.5 across, the fifth resting on the others; four black, one pale grey. Three different piles are needed (the source picks one by seed).

name: SM_Street_Mailbox
description: Street mail collection box, generic, no postal service marks: a barrel-topped steel body 0.52 wide x 0.48 deep, top at 1.20, on four legs 0.27 tall, a pull-down door with a chrome handle on the front (-Y), a label plate reading "MAIL". One of the two variants has a marker scrawl on one side.

name: SM_Street_NewspaperBox
description: Coin-operated newspaper rack: a steel box 0.46 x 0.40 x 0.60 on a pedestal, top at 1.08, a glazed pull-down door on the front (-Y) showing the front page, a coin mechanism, a chrome pull. Paper (invented): masthead "QUEENS NIGHT LEDGER", headline "THREE REELS GONE".

name: SM_Street_Hydrant
description: Fire hydrant 0.75 tall: barrel 0.20 across on a 0.30 flange, a domed bonnet with a pentagonal operating nut, two side hose nozzles and a larger pumper nozzle toward the front (-Y) at height 0.47, each with a galvanised cap.

name: SM_Street_Hydrant_Open
description: The hydrant with its front cap off: an open dark mouth, the cap lying on the ground 0.2 away. The water is an engine effect, not a mesh: a jet from the front outlet at height 0.47 arcing 2.8 m out toward -Y, with wet patches (0.9 radius at the foot, 1.3 radius where it lands).

name: SM_Street_PhoneBooth
description: Kerbside pay-phone kiosk, three-sided, generic: a steel back panel 0.86 x 1.94, two side wings (steel to 0.92, glass above to 1.96), a 0.9 x 0.9 base plate, a head box 0.9 x 0.9 x 0.22 at the top with a lit sign "PHONE" on the front and both sides and a light in the soffit. Inside: a coin phone 0.36 x 0.52 x 0.13 with a 3 x 4 keypad, an instruction card, handset and coiled cord, a small shelf, stickers; a "25¢" coin plate. Open toward -Y. One of the two variants has an oxblood scrawl on a wing.

name: SM_Street_BusShelter
description: Bus shelter 3.6 x 1.5: four slim posts, a shallow roof tray at 2.44 with a light strip under it, a glass back wall in two panes 1.64 x 1.86 between rails, a half pane at the +X end, a lit advertising box 1.26 wide x 1.96 tall closing the -X end, a timber bench 1.9 long at 0.47, a bus-stop flag at the open front corner ("BUS STOP", "NO STANDING"). The ad box carries the IPX one-sheet on both faces, 1.14 x 1.72: "IPX PRESENTS", the title "MURDER" in white over "INC." in gold, "STARRING JA RULE", the IPX lozenge, "IPX.EXCHANGE".
gameplay: cover: glass back 2.30 m, ad box 2.20 m, bench 0.50 m; the roof stops bullets

name: SM_Street_StreetLamp
description: Cobra-head street light: an octagonal tapered steel pole 7.2 tall on a transformer base 0.34 across, a davit arm reaching 1.86 out over the road (toward -Y) with a brace, a cobra-head luminaire 0.74 long whose lens is at height 7.7, 2.16 out from the pole. One of the two variants has a patch of stickers at 1.5 m.
gameplay: cover: a 0.26 m pole to 7.3 m

name: SM_Street_TrafficLight
description: Traffic signal on a mast arm: pole 5.5 tall, an arm reaching 3.25 over the road (toward -Y) at height 5.72, a yellow three-lamp head 0.34 x 0.34 x 1.02 hung at 3.05 out with 0.20 lenses and visors on both faces along X, and a pedestrian head 0.36 x 0.36 on the pole at 2.7 facing -Y (orange hand, white walking figure). Lenses must be separately emissive. In the catalogue but not placed on the block.

name: SM_Street_ParkingMeter
description: Single-head mechanical parking meter: a galvanised post to 1.04 on a small foot, a dark domed head 0.18 across from 1.02 to 1.30 with a dial window on both faces ("1 HR", "25¢").
gameplay: cover: a 0.18 m post to 1.30 m

name: SM_Street_Bench
description: Park bench 1.76 long: three cast-iron supports, four timber seat slats at 0.455, three back slats to 0.84, arm rests at both ends. Seat faces -Y.

name: SM_Street_Planter
description: Square tapered concrete planter, 1.0 at the foot widening to a 1.2 lip at 0.60, soil, and a low clipped hedge to 0.80. Two hedge shapes.

name: SM_Street_Tree
description: Young street tree in summer leaf, 5.7 to 5.9 tall: a slightly leaning trunk 0.26 across at the base forking at 2.7 into three boughs, a crown about 4.6 wide starting 3 m up. Stands in a 0.58 square tree pit with a welded steel guard 0.55 high. Three individual trees.
gameplay: cover: guard 0.55 m, trunk to 3.0 m; the crown has no collision

name: SM_Street_Bollard
description: Steel pipe bollard 0.17 across, 1.0 tall, with a base flange and a domed cap; yellow with a black band from 0.70 to 0.80. Four stand at the shop doors.
gameplay: cover: a 0.18 m post to 1.00 m

name: SM_Street_SignPost
description: Steel channel sign post 2.8 tall with one sign at the top, face toward -Y. Five faces: "NO PARKING ANYTIME" 0.32 x 0.44 (red on white, double arrow); "BUS STOP / NO STANDING" 0.32 x 0.44; "ONE WAY" 0.58 x 0.18 (white arrow on black); "STOP" octagon 0.52 across; and a green street-name blade 0.60 x 0.17 lettered on both faces (default "JAMAICA AV"). In the catalogue but not placed on the block.

name: SM_Street_FencePanel
description: Chain-link fence panel 3.0 wide x 2.4 high: two posts, a top rail, a bottom tension wire, galvanised mesh. Variant with a dark green privacy screen tied to one side up to 2.1 m. In the catalogue but not placed on the block.
gameplay: a solid 8 cm slab 2.40 m high

name: SM_Street_FenceTall
description: Chain-link fence panel 3.0 wide x 4.0 high: two posts, a centre post, top rail, a mid rail at 2.0, bottom wire, mesh. Variant with a dark green screen to 2.3 m. In the catalogue but not placed on the block.
gameplay: a solid 8 cm slab 4.00 m high

name: SM_Street_Manhole
description: Cast-iron manhole cover 0.81 across set in a concrete collar 0.90 across, flush with the road, with two raised rings and twelve lugs. Three of the six on the avenue vent steam (an engine effect).

name: SM_Street_FoodCart
description: Stainless hot-dog cart: body 1.70 x 0.86 x 0.72 on two 0.40 wheels with a jockey leg and a tow bar at the +X end; chrome worktop at 1.0 with a steam pan (lid ajar), a griddle, three squeeze bottles (red, yellow, brown) and a napkin box; a glass sneeze guard along the -Y side; a menu board on both long sides, 1.5 x 0.52: "HOT DOGS", "PRETZELS · COLD SODA", prices "HOT DOG 1.50", "SAUSAGE 2.50", "PRETZEL 1.25", "SODA 1.00"; an eight-panel umbrella in alternating red and yellow, 2.16 x 1.32 across at rim height 1.90, apex 2.23, with a small work lamp under it. Stands on the north sidewalk with two propane tanks beside it.
gameplay: cover: body 1.25 m; the umbrella stops bullets from 1.85 to 2.25 m

name: SM_Prop_MilkCrates
description: A thrown-down stack of plastic dairy crates, each 0.33 x 0.33 x 0.28 with open lattice sides and a solid rim: four on the ground, three on them, one or two on top, slightly askew. Three different stacks. Crate colours mixed.

name: SM_Prop_Pallet
description: Timber pallet 1.2 x 1.0 x 0.144: three bearers 0.09 x 0.09, seven top boards 0.10 wide, three bottom boards. Grey weathered softwood.

name: SM_Prop_PalletStack
description: Eight pallets stacked to 1.15, each a little out of line (about a centimetre and a degree). Two stacks.

name: SM_Prop_CrateWood
description: Plywood shipping crate 1.04 x 0.84 x 0.90 on two skids, with corner posts, top and bottom frames, a diagonal brace on both long sides and a lid. Black stencil on the front (-Y), 0.66 x 0.44: "FRAGILE", "HANDLE WITH CARE", "LOT 0214 · QNS" and an up arrow. A second variant adds the bone-white vulture stencil 0.5 x 0.4 on one end.

name: SM_Prop_CardboardBoxes
description: A loose pile of five corrugated cartons sealed with packing tape, the largest 0.52 x 0.44 x 0.38, two of them stacked with the top one open and its flaps up. Print: "THIS SIDE UP", two arrows, a shipping label with a barcode. Two piles (mirror images).

name: SM_Prop_ShoppingCart
description: Supermarket trolley, generic: a wire basket flaring toward the top (0.60 x 0.38 at the bottom, 0.80 x 0.50 at the rim, 0.93 high), a child-seat flap, a lower tray, a tube frame, four castors, a plastic-sleeved handle at 1.0. Nose at +X. A second pose lying on its side exists in the source but is not used.

name: SM_Prop_Mattress
description: A dumped single mattress lying flat, 1.88 x 0.93 x 0.20, sagging, striped ticking (blue on grey-beige) with water stains.

name: SM_Prop_TireStack
description: Four worn car tyres stacked to 0.97, each 0.77 across with a 0.245 section and a 0.40 bore, turned at random. Two stacks.

name: SM_Prop_OilDrum
description: 55-gallon steel drum, 0.58 across x 0.90, two rolling hoops, a rimmed top with two bungs. Dented and stained. Some carry a paper label 0.19 x 0.12: "MOTOR OIL", "10W-40", "55 GAL · 208 L".

name: SM_Prop_Sandbags
description: A sandbag wall 1.95 long: eleven filled bags in three courses (four, three, four, joints broken), each about 0.55 x 0.59 x 0.335, 0.90 high. Woven polypropylene or hessian, dusty. Two walls.

name: SM_Prop_Generator
description: Skid-mounted diesel generator set in a weather enclosure 2.04 x 0.94 x 1.06 on two skids: louvres on the radiator end (+X) and both flanks, access doors with recessed handles, a gauge panel, an exhaust stack with a rain cap, a lifting eye, a filler cap. Label on both flanks: "DANGER", "HIGH VOLTAGE", "60 kW · 480 V".

name: SM_Prop_FloodlightStand
description: Tripod work light: three legs to a 0.47 radius, a telescopic mast to 2.0, a cross bar 0.84 wide carrying two halogen flood heads 0.34 x 0.25 x 0.10 aimed forward (-Y) and 18 degrees down, a trailing cable. Lenses must be separately emissive.
gameplay: cover: a 0.44 m post to 2.15 m

name: SM_Prop_PortaPotty
description: Portable toilet: a moulded cabin 1.12 square x 1.96 on a 1.2 base, a translucent white roof cap, a door on the front (-Y) with a latch showing a green "vacant" dot, side vents, a vent stack. Hire plate on the door (invented): "HOLLIS", "SITE SERVICES", "UNIT 14".

name: SM_Prop_CarLift
description: Two-post vehicle lift: two columns 0.30 x 0.26 x 3.46, 2.8 apart across the bay, on base plates, tied by an overhead beam at 3.52; a carriage on each column with two swing arms about 1.0 long ending in round pads; a power unit with a reservoir on one column. Arms raised: pad tops 2.14 above the floor (a car on them has its wheels 1.95 up). A car lies along the X axis. Model the arms as a part that can also sit lowered at 0.16.
gameplay: cover: two posts 0.40 x 0.32 m to 3.50 m; a raised car above 1.95 m

name: SM_Prop_ToolChest
description: Mechanic's roller cabinet 1.06 x 0.50 x 0.62 with five drawers and a top chest 1.02 x 0.46 x 0.33 with three, aluminium drawer pulls, four castors, a side handle. Drawers face -Y.

name: SM_Prop_Workbench
description: Workbench 2.2 x 0.78 with a thick timber top at 0.80 on an angle-iron frame and a plywood lower shelf. Dressing: a red toolbox, a carton and a can on the shelf; a blue bench vise on the front corner; a carburettor on a rag, a tray of sockets and a coffee cup on top.

name: SM_Prop_EngineHoist
description: Folding engine crane (cherry picker): splayed legs on castors, a mast 1.5 tall, a boom to a tip 1.92 high, a hydraulic ram with a pump handle; a V engine block 0.52 x 0.40 x 0.34 hanging from the hook on a chain at height 1.08.
gameplay: cover: mast to 1.60 m, the hanging engine 0.85 to 1.38 m

name: SM_Prop_ShelfRack
description: Pallet racking 2.7 x 0.87 x 3.0: two braced upright frames, four pairs of beams at 0.14, 0.98, 1.82 and 2.62 with plywood decks. Loaded: tyres in three piles on the bottom, cartons on the second level, three parts bins and four oil cans on the third, a carton and a timber box on top. Two loads.
gameplay: hard cover: a solid 0.90 m deep block to 3.00 m

name: SM_Prop_Compressor
description: Wheeled workshop air compressor: a horizontal tank 0.92 long x 0.40 across on two 0.24 wheels and a foot, an electric motor and a finned pump on top under a belt guard, a pressure gauge, a tow handle with a coiled yellow air hose.

name: SM_Prop_VendingMachine
description: Soda vending machine 0.90 x 0.76 x 1.84, generic: a black cabinet, a tall back-lit face 0.6 x 1.2 on the front (-Y) reading "ICE COLD SODA" with a "$1.00" price tag on a blue-to-cyan field with bubbles (invented brandless art), a column of six selection buttons, a coin slot, a delivery bin.

name: SM_Prop_Hoop
description: Playground basketball hoop, long along X: a gooseneck steel post 0.12 across standing at x -0.78, rising to 3.56 and curving forward to a steel backboard 1.20 wide x 1.05 tall at x +0.12 (centre height 3.45, facing +X); an orange rim 0.46 across at height 3.05; a chain net 0.385 long. Board white with a worn orange border and target rectangle.
gameplay: cover: a 0.16 m post; the board stops bullets from 2.9 to 4.0 m

name: SM_Prop_Bleachers
description: Four-row aluminium bleacher 4.0 long x 1.96 deep: plank seats at 0.42, 0.78, 1.14 and 1.50 (lowest toward -Y), foot boards, three welded steel frames, a back rail at 1.58. Rows are 0.49 apart.

name: SM_Street_CourtLight
description: Sports-court floodlight mast: a tapered steel pole 8.55 tall on a 0.38 base, a cross arm at 8.7 carrying four flood heads 0.42 x 0.28, one to each side, each tilted 40 degrees down. Lenses must be separately emissive.

name: SM_Street_LotBooth
description: Parking attendant's booth 2.1 x 1.7 on a 2.2 x 1.8 concrete slab: steel walls to a sill at 1.05, glazing above on the front (-Y) and both ends, a blind back wall, a door with a window on the +X end, a flat roof with a lip to 2.37 and a small roof unit to 2.59. Signs (invented): "PARK" / "24 HOURS" in gold on black, 1.6 x 0.56, under the front window; a tariff board 0.5 x 0.65 by the door: "RATES", "FIRST HOUR $6", "EACH ADD’L $3", "ALL NIGHT $14", "LOST TICKET $30", "NO IN & OUT".

name: SM_Sign_Billboard_IPX
description: Roadside billboard over the parking lot: two riveted steel legs 0.34 square, 5.2 apart, cross-braced with three horizontal ties; a truss frame carrying a face 9.0 wide x 4.1 tall from 6.7 to 10.8 (facing -Y); a grated catwalk with a railing under the face at 6.35; a ladder on the +X leg; four lamp arms throwing light up the face. Face art 8.9 x 4.0: near-black field, the IPX lozenge in white (about half the face height), a gold rule as wide as the lozenge, "IPX.EXCHANGE" in bold white capitals below. Swappable texture for the real logo.
gameplay: cover: two legs 0.40 m square; the face stops bullets from 6.3 m up

name: SM_Architecture_WaterTower
description: New York rooftop water tank: a wooden stave tank 2.6 across from 2.13 to 4.10 with five iron hoops and a conical roof to 4.98, on a braced steel stand 1.9 tall (four legs 2.0 apart), three timber bearers, a riser pipe, a ladder up the side. Seen from the street against the sky.

name: SM_Architecture_ACUnit
description: Packaged rooftop air-conditioning unit 1.16 x 0.86 x 0.74 on two skids: a fan under a guard on top, louvres along one side, an access panel, a conduit.

name: SM_Architecture_FireEscape
description: One storey of a New York fire escape as a stackable module 3.0 high, wall at +Y: a steel grating landing 2.9 x 1.05 at height 0.25 on two brackets, a railing of square bars to 1.20 on three sides, and a steep stair rising from the +X end to a hatch at the -X end of the landing above. Stacked two to four high on four facades. Optional forms in the source (unused): a top module with a ladder to the roof, a bottom module with a drop ladder.

name: SM_Architecture_Awning
description: Fabric shed awning 4.0 wide projecting 1.28 from the wall (wall at +Y), sloping from 0.90 at the wall to 0.34 at the lip, with a scalloped valance hanging to 0.10 and a pipe frame. Variants: alternate panels white; shop name lettered on the valance. In the catalogue but not placed: the level builds its awnings itself.
